title: Three Summers and One Short Pan
subtitle: 矿产资源 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 矿产资源（人与自然·自然生态·资源与利用）
meta: 主题语境：矿产资源（人与自然·自然生态·资源与利用）　|　核心词汇：gold　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 gold 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the prospector ① weighed the gold that no partner in the camp would have described, and he said the weighing was the whole of the summer. The ② gold, meaning the metal itself and not the stone, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; gold, he said, is the only thing in a camp that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ piece of gold in that camp had the same short pan beside it, and the ④ gold at the far bank, meaning the dust they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Gold, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the prospector said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the gold was the whole of the matter, meaning the colour and not the metal. The ⑥ gold, meaning the colour and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; gold, he said, is either something you weigh or the only word that means both a metal and a colour. He said the colour is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ gold had become a line in a claim, and the claim had become an argument about the short pan. The ⑧ gold of the whole thing, the prospector wrote in November, was one camp and three summers of describing; gold, he said, is either the dust at the far bank or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ gold I remember is the gold described in the claim, which closed in 1975 and is still described as the quietest in the camp. ⑩ Gold, my mother said in 1977, is the only metal that improves by being described; all gold, she said, is a colour that has agreed to look like a metal. She said the colour was the honest half.

gold 意为“黄金”，指那种金属本身而不是石头，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
gold 意为“黄金”，指营地里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只矮矮的淘盘。
gold 意为“黄金”，指最远那处河岸上留给孩子们看的那些金砂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
gold 意为“金色”，指一件事里人人都说却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片金色就是那件事的全部。
gold 意为“金色”，指人人都说却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些黄金，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
gold 意为“黄金”，指矿权文件里写到、被记录过的那些，到 1973 年这些成了文件里的一行。
gold 意为“黄金”，探矿人十一月写道，整件事的淘金之事是一处营地和三个夏天的描述。
gold 意为“黄金”，我记得的是文件里描述过的那些，1975 年分完了，至今仍被说成营地里最安静的一批。
gold 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，黄金是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的金属。
